purpose: Authorize exactly one future claim-bound execution of the unchanged D-122 MapLight robustness battery, only after the two additive scientific sources pass reviewed official-shaped synthetic execution and scoring acceptance at exact integrated hashes.
hypothesis: Exact fixed MapLight is stable to the prospectively frozen feature, seed, grouping, duplicate, influence, source, endpoint, and clipping challenges, or one predeclared drop-one simplification is materially superior under every D-122 selection and robustness gate.
targeted_failure: Accepted no-fit mechanics can still fail through official-source or baseline drift, real-fit parameter drift, premature truth access, scoring or bootstrap drift, resource exhaustion, partial publication, cleanup failure, or outcome-driven repair.
occam_boundary: Reuse the accepted compiler, no-fit wrapper, cumulative supervisor, MapLight runner, and metric source unchanged. Add only one scientific runner, one single-use attempt driver, one official-shaped execution/scoring acceptance driver, its aggregate acceptance, and focused tests. Add no candidate, feature, seed, group, fit, metric, clip, calibration, blend, threshold, retry, repair, resume, cache, concurrency change, framework, or service.

accepted_implementation.extension_rule: The future scientific runner may only turn accepted model capabilities into exact CatBoost predictions and apply D-122 scoring, selection, diagnostics, and aggregate terminal arithmetic. The future attempt driver may only authenticate and consume the one claim, start the accepted supervisor before consumption, invoke the accepted compiler and scientific runner, enforce cleanup, and publish one terminal. Their exact hashes and official-shaped acceptance must enter the private consumed claim before an official byte opens.

claim_contract.unconsumed_placeholders: Every future_* field is null and usable is false in the tracked immutable template. After reviewed integration and green post-main CI, one private canonical consumed claim may fill exactly those five nulls without changing a frozen field.
claim_contract.consumption: The accepted cumulative supervisor starts before atomic no-replace creation of the fixed private attempt root and attempt_claim.json consumes the sole claim. The tracked template never mutates. Acceptance, scientific rejection, underpowered preflight, resource abort, failure, crash, or interruption remains consumed and permits no retry, resume, move, overwrite, repair, or replacement.
claim_contract.precondition: Consumption is forbidden until a separately reviewed aggregate acceptance binds the exact future sources and proves two fresh opposite-order official-shaped roots, exact D-122 scoring and both conditional paths, exactly two bounded real CatBoost execution controls, cumulative supervision, cleanup, deterministic aggregate terminals, and zero official or forbidden operations.

official_inputs.read_boundary: This milestone records existing aggregate receipt strings and verifies only that the future fixed attempt root is absent. It does not list, parse, copy, link, hash, or otherwise open a row-level official source or baseline file. A valid private consumed claim is required before the future attempt driver may open allowlisted roots.

source_and_capability_boundary.compilation: Use the accepted D-126 compiler in official mode at its fixed source root and exact authorization schema. Reconstruct accepted structures and the primary, inclusive-0.55, inclusive-0.50, and canonical-tautomer-merged families before any scientific fit; exclude every overlay component touching confirmatory membership.
source_and_capability_boundary.model_capability: Each fit sees only its endpoint's current family-safe outer-training finite-central targets, its exact ordered feature view, and label-free prediction identities. It cannot resolve validation truth, baseline rows, scorer state, another endpoint, confirmatory, historical, blinded-test, TDI, external, submission, official-metric, portal, or upload paths.
source_and_capability_boundary.scorer_capability: Each stage scorer remains unreadable until every required prediction for that stage is canonically frozen. Stage A alone may open immutable full-MapLight baseline outer OOF after all 540 new stage-A fits freeze. No scorer capability may write a model capability or change a fit identity.
source_and_capability_boundary.underpowered: Any parent, claim, source, structure, family, support, feature, truth, fold, baseline, runtime, or capability mismatch consumes the attempt, runs zero fits when detected at preflight, publishes only G2_7_MAPLIGHT_ROBUSTNESS_UNDERPOWERED after cleanup, and cannot alter a component, mask, candidate, seed, group, or denominator.

scientific_execution.fit_order: Run one fit process at a time with sixteen threads. Within each stage use the D-126 canonical FitIdentity order. Stage B starts only after stage-A prediction freeze and one immutable selection token. Stage C runs only when that token names a deletion.
scientific_execution.prediction_freeze: Every prediction must be finite float64 with one unique D-126 identity. Canonically sort and atomically freeze a complete stage before its matching validation truth or baseline capability can open. Missing, extra, duplicate, warned, failed, nonfinite, parameter-drifted, interrupted, or replaced work fails the consumed attempt; unused capacity cannot fund repair.

stage_a_selection.drop_one_material_gate: Tutorial-primary relative improvement is at least 0.01 or component-macro MAE improvement is at least 0.005 versus immutable exact full MapLight on identical primary D-032 rows.
stage_a_selection.paired_gate: The paired component-bootstrap upper 95 percent bound of candidate minus full component-macro MAE is strictly below zero.
stage_a_selection.cell_gate: At least 8 of 15 repeat-by-outer-fold cells have strictly lower candidate component-macro MAE.
stage_a_selection.endpoint_gate: No endpoint component-macro MAE degradation exceeds 0.005.
stage_a_selection.ordering: Among eligible deletions choose fewer feature columns, then lower tutorial-primary value, then lower component-macro MAE, then lexicographically smaller candidate_id; otherwise retain G2-7-M0-FULL.

primary_metric.name_boundary: Pinned local tutorial proxy only; live-backend parity remains unverified.

robustness_evaluation.component_macro_mae: Give every active component equal weight within endpoint, then each of four endpoints equal macro weight.

paired_bootstrap.unit: sorted original D-032 component union with all eligible endpoint rows retained per draw
paired_bootstrap.interval: linearly interpolated 0.025 and 0.975 quantiles of candidate-minus-full component-macro MAE

robustness_evaluation.source_gate: Authenticate exactly one accepted source value and publish SINGLE_SOURCE_NOT_APPLICABLE; any second or unavailable source fails.
robustness_evaluation.logic: Selection and every applicable seed, grouping, duplicate, influence, source, endpoint, clipping, constituent, support, containment, chronology, accounting, resource, and cleanup gate are conjunctive. No diagnostic may revise the single selection token.

runtime_and_resources.measurement: The accepted cumulative supervisor starts before claim consumption and measures the trusted compiler, every model child, scorer, bootstrap, diagnostic, publisher, temporary file, cleanup action, and descendant until terminal publication attempt and cleanup finish. Poll at most once per second and enforce every limit during child fits.
runtime_and_resources.acceptance: Every scientific identity must complete and every hard maximum must pass conjunctively. Equality passes non-GPU maxima; GPU visibility or use must equal zero. Any limit, warning, fallback, nonzero exit, signal, timeout, detached child, missing checkpoint, partial publication, or incomplete accounting aborts without a scientific terminal.
runtime_and_resources.budget_rule: Unused capacity cannot fund a retry, resume, moved root, repair, alternate order, smaller battery, extra candidate, seed, threshold, feature, metric, clip, model, optimization, cache, concurrency change, or runner-up.

terminal_contract.publication: Publish exactly one aggregate-only read-only terminal after cleanup. It may contain exact receipts, selected candidate and recipe, aggregate gate values, fit and prediction counts, cumulative resources, cleanup, accounting, and status. Raw structures, targets, intervals, feature matrices, component memberships, models, row-level predictions, paired rows, unrestricted logs, and private portal observations remain private.
terminal_contract.cleanup: Before terminal publication remove target, model, scorer, truth, and baseline capabilities; writable model state; feature links or copies; stage predictions; paired rows; CatBoost state; staging roots; and the restricted work root. Retain only the read-only consumed claim, aggregate receipt, and status-specific terminal. Cleanup failure changes any scientific status to G2_7_MAPLIGHT_ROBUSTNESS_FAILED.
terminal_contract.failure: Any parent, claim, source, structure, family, feature, capability, fit, parameter, prediction-freeze, paired-join, metric, bootstrap, selection, diagnostic, accounting, resource, cleanup, publication, or authority defect is terminal with no retry, resume, move, overwrite, repair, replacement, runner-up, or reinterpretation.

forbidden.boundary: Confirmatory truth, historical row-level artifacts outside the three allowlisted fixed-baseline files, blinded test, TDI, external records, submission generation, live official metric, leaderboard selection, and upload remain outside G2-7D under every terminal.

targeted_failure_modes: V1/V2 molecule, exact-duplicate, original-component, threshold-component, or tautomer-component leakage
V3 validation truth, baseline, metric, or diagnostic access before complete matching prediction freeze
V4 parent, source, runtime, feature, parameter, candidate, seed, group, fit, prediction, or execution-order drift
V6 tutorial-metric or paired-bootstrap arithmetic represented as a verified live score
C4/C5/C6 tautomer, charge-state, duplicate, influential-family, or unjustified-feature sensitivity
E1/S4 endpoint, source, grouping-threshold, clipping, or calibration instability
P1/P5/P6 resource, process-tree, warning, partial-publication, cleanup, retry, overwrite, or forbidden-capability contamination
next_gate: Implement only the additive scientific runner, single-use attempt driver, official-shaped execution/scoring acceptance driver, and focused tests. After reviewed signed integration and green post-main CI, run exactly one formal two-root synthetic acceptance with zero official operations. Do not consume the claim, open an official byte, fit a scientific model, evaluate a development metric, access confirmatory truth, generate a submission, use leaderboard evidence for selection, or upload in that milestone.
